excerpt: Dupely is a free browser extension and app for Amazon shoppers that finds identical products sold for less, flags fake discounts using 90 days of price history and rates sellers. What it does, limits and alternatives.
content:
Dupely is a free shopping assistant for Amazon, available as a Chrome extension and as iOS and Android apps. Its makers built it after getting frustrated with duplicate listings, where the same product is sold under different brand names at different prices. When you land on a product page, Dupely looks at the images, specs, seller information and price to find identical listings and scores each match from 0 to 100 (its DupeScore or MatchScore). A feature called Trust This Price uses 90 days of price history to flag discounts that are not real, and seller badges show which sellers look credible. It also surfaces price drops, deals of the day and promo codes. A launch graphic lists checks for fake reviews and paid influencers as coming soon.

Dupely is made by Dupely, Inc. Its terms say the service is intended for use in the United States and that it is built for Amazon first, with more marketplaces planned. Co-founder and CTO Jacob Galajda said on Product Hunt that price history comes from several data vendors' APIs rather than real-time scraping. It launched on Product Hunt on 7 July 2026 and finished #4 for the day with 262 points and 116 comments.

We have not tested Dupely ourselves. This page brings together its official site, its Product Hunt page and the public pages of the products it is compared with, and says where each fact comes from.

Its privacy policy says it collects activity data including referral clicks.

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Honey
items.what: Free extension that searches for coupons at 30,000+ sites
items.difference: Focuses on coupon codes. Dupely focuses on identical cheaper listings and fake discounts.

items.name: Chestr
items.what: Free universal wishlist that alerts you to discounts at any store
items.difference: Tracks prices on items you save across stores. Dupely compares listings on Amazon.

items.name: Faircado
items.what: AI assistant that finds second-hand alternatives while you shop
items.difference: Points you to second-hand offers rather than identical new listings.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Beni and Reverse Dropshipping as alternatives.

quotes.author: Dipankar Sarkar
quotes.text: Deciding two listings are the 'same product' is the whole game, and Amazon makes it ugly
quotes.reply: Ryan Butz: it compares price per unit so it doesn't recommend a 90-count bottle against a 270-count one.

quotes.author: Bahar
quotes.text: How do you actually get the 90 days of price history for every product?
quotes.reply: Jacob Galajda: from several data vendors' APIs; there are some coverage gaps for small or niche brands.

quotes.author: Naime Fidanoğlu
quotes.text: DupeScore saved me like $12 on a serum that's literally identical to the pricier one.

faq.a: A free Chrome extension and mobile app that finds identical Amazon products sold for less, flags fake discounts and rates sellers. It launched on Product Hunt on 7 July 2026.
Yes. The extension and apps are free, according to its site and Product Hunt.

faq.q: How does Trust This Price work?
faq.a: It checks 90 days of price history to flag discounts that are not genuine. The makers say the data comes from third-party data vendors.
